meta.name: tdd
meta.description: Test-driven development with red-green-refactor loop. Use when user wants to build features or fix bugs using TDD, mentions "red-green-refactor", wants integration tests, or asks for test-first development.

copy.tagline: 用红绿重构循环驱动功能开发与缺陷修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果习惯先写测试再写代码，追求高质量开发
copy.tagline_en: Drive feature development and bug fixes with red-green-refactor loop
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you prefer writing tests before code and aim for high quality

howto.what: Claude 会引导你按照红-绿-重构循环进行测试驱动开发：先写一个测试（红），再写最少代码让它通过（绿），然后重构。每次只写一个测试，不提前写多个测试。
howto.when: 当你提到“红-绿-重构”、要求测试优先开发、想用 TDD 构建功能或修复 bug 时触发。

say.text: 用 TDD 帮我写一个用户登录功能。
say.note: Claude 会先和你确认接口和行为，然后开始红-绿循环。

say.text: 我想用红-绿-重构修复这个 bug。
say.note: Claude 会引导你写一个失败的测试，再修复代码。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through the red-green-refactor loop: write one failing test (red), write minimal code to pass (green), then refactor. One test at a time, no bulk test writing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "red-green-refactor", want test-first development, or ask to build features or fix bugs using TDD.

say_en.text: Use TDD to build a user login feature.
say_en.note: Claude will confirm interface and behaviors, then start the red-green loop.

say_en.text: Let's fix this bug with red-green-refactor.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to write a failing test, then fix the code.
